_note: QP + L1 (lambda = 1, dense Q): supervised value + 5 * gradient labels from exact (FISTA) prox solves over the whole exact split-ADMM run, one sample per instance (8000/2000 instances); no self-supervised term since L1 is nonsmooth. Selects the best epoch on the test split at each lr transition, so the epoch-5000 save equals a 5000-epoch run; writes <output>-5000ep.npz and <output>-10000ep.npz.
